env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 5: a Go importer sees a closed union value type as its methods-only
# interface. The same Go source compiles against the logos build and
# against the ejected dependency and prints the same output.
cd gapp
logos run .
stdout '^who: A:1 B:two$'
stdout '^describe: A:1 B:two$'
stdout '^hole: N$'
stdout '^check: member non-member$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/main.go
exists bout/_logos_deps/example.com/lpu@v1.0.0/u/u.go
cd bout
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..
cd ..

-- gapp/go.mod --
module example.com/gapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lpu v1.0.0

replace example.com/lpu v1.0.0 => ../lpu

-- gapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lpu/u"
)

var _ func(u.U) string = u.Who
var _ func(int) u.U = u.Pick
var _ u.U = interface{ M() string }(nil)
var _ interface{ M() string } = u.U(nil)

type N struct{}

func (N) M() string { return "N" }

func describe(x u.U) string {
	switch v := x.(type) {
	case u.A:
		return fmt.Sprintf("A:%d", v.X)
	case u.B:
		return "B:" + v.Y
	}
	return "other"
}

func main() {
	a, b := u.Pick(0), u.Pick(1)
	fmt.Println("who:", u.Who(a), u.Who(b))
	fmt.Println("describe:", describe(a), describe(b))
	fmt.Println("hole:", u.Who(N{}))
	fmt.Println("check:", u.Check(u.A{X: 9}), u.Check(42))
}

-- lpu/go.mod --
module example.com/lpu

go 1.27

-- lpu/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "fmt"

type A struct {
	X int
}

func (a A) M() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("A:%d", a.X)
}

type B struct {
	Y string
}

func (b B) M() string {
	return "B:" + b.Y
}

type U interface {
	A | B
	M() string
}

func Who(x U) string {
	return x.M()
}

func Pick(n int) U {
	if n == 0 {
		return A{X: 1}
	}
	return B{Y: "two"}
}

func Check(v any) string {
	if _, ok := v.(U); ok {
		return "member"
	}
	return "non-member"
}
